notes.title: 🔥 Fire system – first look
notes.content:
Here’s a first look at our fire system in action. Everything you see is physical — no scripted burning
[u](Burning process below is sped up for clarity)[/u]
[img]https://naturegam.es/paleolith/images/fire.gif[/img]
[list]  [*]Logs burn down into chunks and disappear over time[/*]  [*]Fire spreads between physically interacting logs[/*]  [*]Sparks fly as wood crackles and shifts[/*]  [*]Each log is a real object you can add to the fire[/*][/list]
Next up: natural smoke, glowing embers, ash — and burning any stick you find in the woods.

Still early and rough, but already brings the fire to life.
